_note: Quote backfill pilot (2026-11-24): the sentence or infobox field in the cited article that states each event's date, appended to its section-only locator by scripts/ancient-classical/locator-quotes.ts. 'dateBy' says how the quote gives the stored year when it states a range; 'latestBy' marks a quote that gives the latest the event can be ('by 300 AD'), not its year; 'none' flags an event no passage of its cited article dates. Checked by pipelines/ancient/locator_quotes.py --check. Nothing changes a date.
